questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about co-prime numbers?
choices: They have at least one common prime factor
They have exactly two common prime factors
They have no common prime factors
They have all prime factors in common
questions.solution: Co-prime numbers are defined as numbers that do not share any common prime factors. This means the correct statement is that they have no common prime factors. The first option is wrong because co-prime numbers do not have any common prime factors. The second option is incorrect because it implies a specific number of common factors, which is not true. The fourth option is also wrong because it suggests they share all prime factors, which is the opposite of co-primality.

questions.stem: Which rule is used to check if a number is divisible by 8?
choices: Check if the last digit is even
Check if the sum of all digits is divisible by 8
Check if the number formed by the last three digits is divisible by 8
Check if the number is a multiple of 10
questions.solution: The correct rule for checking if a number is divisible by 8 is to check if the number formed by the last three digits is divisible by 8. This is because 1000 is divisible by 8, so any number's divisibility by 8 depends only on its last three digits. Checking if the last digit is even relates to divisibility by 2, checking the sum of digits relates to divisibility by 3 or 9, and checking if the number is a multiple of 10 relates to divisibility by 10.

questions.stem: If a number is divisible by 8, which of the following must also be true?
questions.solution: If a number is divisible by 8, it must also be divisible by 4 because 8 is a multiple of 4. The number being divisible by 16 is not necessary, as not all multiples of 8 are multiples of 16. Divisibility by 2 is always true for even numbers, but it is not specific to 8. Divisibility by 6 is not guaranteed because 6 and 8 are not multiples of each other.

questions.stem: The number 8560 needs its last two digits changed to make it a multiple of 8. Which of the following is a valid new number?
questions.solution: A number is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8. The original number is 8560. Changing the last two digits to 68 makes the last three digits 568, which is divisible by 8. 8564 ends in 564, which is not divisible by 8. 8570 ends in 570, which is not divisible by 8. 8572 ends in 572, which is not divisible by 8.

questions.stem: What is the smallest number that is a multiple of all the numbers from 1 to 10 except for 7?
questions.solution: The smallest number that is a multiple of all the numbers from 1 to 10 except 7 is 2520. 2250 is not a multiple of 8, 2100 is not a multiple of 8 or 9, and 1890 is not a multiple of 8 or 4.

hi.solution: 1 से 10 तक के सभी संख्याओं के एक गुणज होने वाली सबसे छोटी संख्या 2520 है। 2250 8 का गुणज नहीं है, 2100 8 या 9 का गुणज नहीं है और 1890 8 या 4 का गुणज नहीं है।

mr.solution: 1 ते 10 पर्यंतच्या सर्व संख्यांचा गुणक असणारी लहानतम संख्या 7 व्यतिरिक्त 2520 आहे. 2250 8 चा गुणक नाही, 2100 8 किंवा 9 चा गुणक नाही आणि 1890 8 किंवा 4 चा गुणक नाही.

questions.stem: Two numbers, 4 and 9, are safe. What does it mean for a pair of numbers to be safe?
choices: They have no common factor other than 1
questions.solution: A pair of numbers is considered safe if they have no common factor other than 1. This means they are co-prime. The numbers 4 and 9 are safe because they are co-prime. The other options do not define what it means for a pair to be safe.

hi.stem: 4 और 9 दो संख्याएँ सुरक्षित हैं। दो संख्याओं के सुरक्षित होने का क्या अर्थ है?
choices: उनका एक से अधिक सामान्य गुणनखंड नहीं है
hi.solution: एक जोड़ी संख्याओं को सुरक्षित माना जाता है यदि उनका केवल 1 के अलावा कोई सामान्य गुणनखंड नहीं होता है। इसका अर्थ है कि वे सह-अभाज्य हैं। संख्याएँ 4 और 9 सुरक्षित हैं क्योंकि वे सह-अभाज्य हैं। अन्य विकल्प दो संख्याओं के सुरक्षित होने का अर्थ निर्दिष्ट नहीं करते।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: 4 आणि 9 हे दोन संख्या, सुरक्षित आहेत. एका संख्याच्या जोडीला सुरक्षित म्हणणे काय अर्थ आहे?
choices: त्यांचा 1 शिवाय कोणताही सामायिक अपवर्तक नाही
mr.solution: एका संख्याच्या जोडीला सुरक्षित म्हणतात जर त्यांचा 1 शिवाय कोणताही सामायिक अपवर्तक नसेल. हा अर्थ त्यांना सह-अभाज्य म्हणतात. 4 आणि 9 ही संख्या सह-अभाज्य असल्याने त्यांना सुरक्षित म्हणतात. इतर विकल्प एका संख्याच्या जोडीला सुरक्षित म्हणण्याचा अर्थ निर्दिष्ट करत नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: If 80 and 63 have no common prime factors, what can be concluded about them?
questions.solution: If two numbers have no common prime factors, they are co-prime. Since 80 and 63 share no prime factors, they are co-prime. The other options are incorrect because 80 is not prime, 63 is not a multiple of 5, and 80 is even.

hi.stem: यदि 80 और 63 के कोई सामान्य अभाज्य गुणनखंड नहीं हैं, तो इनके बारे में क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है?
hi.solution: यदि दो संख्याओं के कोई सामान्य अभाज्य गुणनखंड नहीं हैं, तो वे सह-अभाज्य होती हैं। 80 और 63 के कोई सामान्य अभाज्य गुणनखंड नहीं हैं, इसलिए वे सह-अभाज्य हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि 80 अभाज्य नहीं है, 63, 5 का गुणज नहीं है, और 80 सम संख्या है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the meaning, structure, and terminology of the original English question. The term 'सह-अभाज्य' is the standard Hindi term for 'co-prime' used in textbooks.

mr.stem: 80 आणि 63 च्या सामाईक अविभाज्य अवयव नसल्यास, त्यांबद्दल काय निष्कर्ष काढता येईल?
mr.solution: जर दोन संख्यांचा सामाईक अविभाज्य अवयव नसेल तर ते सह-अविभाज्य असतात. कारण 80 आणि 63 चा सामाईक अविभाज्य अवयव नाही, तर ते सह-अविभाज्य आहेत. इतर विकल्प चूक आहेत कारण 80 अविभाज्य नाही, 63 5 चा गुणक नाही आणि 80 सम संख्या आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Marathi mathematical terminology.
